name: agent-forge
description: Codex workflow plugin for user-controlled, composable multi-agent orchestration.

interface.longDescription: Agent Forge provides Codex-compatible workflow skills for user-controlled, low-intrusion, composable multi-agent orchestration. Its current Plan skill turns ambiguous software or workflow requests into a local draft plan, waits for user confirmation, then upgrades the same Markdown file to a final execution checklist.
